decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1). 7A College Road is a powerful building for its size, performing its function as a 'gateway house' to the Parklands Grove development well, with particular style, consistency and attention to detail. The pyramidal roof and projecting gables and bays give an individualism, which helps the dwelling turn the corner, create an interesting  skyline and addresses the rear development. No.7A, should be retained in order to preserve the character of the Conservation Area, its loss would only serve to be detrimental to the character of the Conservation Area. Therefore, the development is not in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV.B.2.2 and H.6.3 (Backland/Infill Development) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

2) The proposed design of the dwelling is non-authentic, with its detailing and form failing to create a style and consistency that would be in keeping with the area and would thus fail to preserve or enhance the character of the Conservation Area. This is contrary to Policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the London Borough Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 2 - 2) The proposed design of the dwelling is non-authentic, with its detailing and form failing to create a style and consistency that would be in keeping with the area and would thus fail to preserve or enhance the character of the Conservation Area. This is contrary to Policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the London Borough Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.

Condition : 3 - 3) The proposed off street parking would dominant the front elevation and remove the front boundary wall and planting area. It would therefore fail to preserve and enhance the Conservation Area. This is contrary to Policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the London Borough Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and the Council's  Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Demolition of existing house and the erection of 2 X four bedroom semi-detached houses to existing site.
